title: Watering can with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body of watering can -->
  <rect x='30' y='42' width='42' height='34' rx='7' fill='#39c6ff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='66' width='42' height='10' rx='5' fill='#1f9fd6'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M38 44 q0 -18 14 -18 q14 0 14 18' fill='none' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M30 58 L12 40 L9 44 L27 62 Z' fill='#1f9fd6'/>
  <rect x='6' y='34' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#39c6ff' transform='rotate(-35 10 40)'/>
  <!-- sprinkler holes -->
  <circle cx='9' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#c9f3ff'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#c9f3ff'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='54' r='3' fill='#0e3b52'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='54' r='3' fill='#0e3b52'/>
  <path d='M43 62 q8 8 16 0' fill='none' stroke='#0e3b52' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fb1' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fb1' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
